item.title: B.C. man feared a ‘hit’ on him before he and family died, inquest hears
item.description: A police officer testifying at an inquest into the death of a family in Prince Rupert in 2023 says the father believed he would be the target of a "hit."

item.title: B.C. companies report declining profits as trade war with U.S. continues
item.description: The trade war between Canada and U.S. has now been raging for a year, and almost half of all small businesses in B.C. report that it is hurting their bottom lines.

item.title: Police investigating hit-and-run involving pedestrians in North Vancouver
item.description: The North Vancouver RCMP says it is investigating a reported hit-and-run involving two pedestrians Saturday evening.
